changeSet.comment: Supprime les scores en double (garde le meilleur par user_id + game_type ; maze : plus petit score non nul) puis ajoute une contrainte UNIQUE
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM scores WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY user_id, game_type ORDER BY CASE WHEN game_type = 'maze' THEN (CASE WHEN score = 0 THEN 2147483647 ELSE score END)::BIGINT ELSE -score::BIGINT END ASC, "timestamp" DESC, id ASC ) AS rn FROM scores ) ranked WHERE ranked.rn > 1 )
